description: A small waiting room with a desk, two chairs, and every wall covered in work, hung edge to edge and floor to picture rail without a gap anywhere. Faces, mostly. A few groups. Three of a building. The frames do not match and the hanging is immaculate. A ledger on the desk is open at a page of names with times beside them, and a second column, headed only with a dash, in which most of the entries are a single word.

window.description: A shopfront window mostly filled by the back of the display case, so what you get of the street is a strip above the frames and a strip below them. People stop at the case and she watches them decide.
window.name: the shopfront

name: Negative Equity — The Front
